description: List the jobs this account submitted, newest first — DAW conversions (convert_project) and bounces (bounce_session) — to find an earlier result, check what is still running, or resume after a lost connection. Each row names its artifacts; doseedo_check_task {job_id} returns the full result with fresh links. Read-only.

before.description: Page cursor: the next_cursor of a previous call.

kind.description: Only this job kind: convert_project or bounce_session (convert / bounce are accepted aliases).

session_id.description: Only jobs whose input names this session (its bounces), filtered within the fetched page.

name: doseedo_list_jobs
title: List jobs
